Of course, getting started can feel like a lot at first 😊

The main denim fit options in simple terms are:

• Skinny: fitted closely from waist to ankle for a sleek look
• Straight: more relaxed than skinny, with a clean straight shape through the leg
• Bootcut: fitted through the top with a slight flare at the bottom
• Flare: fitted through the hips and thighs, then wider from the knee down
• Wide leg: loose and roomy through the leg for a more relaxed feel
• Boyfriend: relaxed and casual with an easy fit
• Barrel leg: roomier through the leg with a more shaped silhouette
• Crops and shorts: shorter lengths for warmer weather or a different look
